1933, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 103 Cont.
Apr. 12 Highland
Henry Chase - 43 - liver trouble
Mrs. Louise Bonner - 52 - Pt. Huron, Arthritis
Miss N. Heffernan - 58 - gall-stones & liver trouble - in terrible pain - can't walk Mrs. Quigley - 61 - Act Grat. Julin Foley - 57 - headaches
Page 104 Page 105
Blank Page
April Mary O'Connel - 57 - cancer
Sister M. Agnes I.H.M. - 25 - had"flu", now fears T.B. of bone.
Ambrose Langlois and brothers, sisters, widowed mother from out of town - want work.
Edw'd Collins - 10 - sarcomac Cancer at 32
Mrs. Augusta Fraley - 71 - near Pt. Huron - cancer feared
Jos. Girard - 69 - prayed for two weeks ago - Had been enrolled for sometime before. - (out of) away from holy sacraments 40 years - + made his confession & received holy Viaticum.
Mrs. Claire Joanise - 30 - Threatened cancer of breast & stomach. . .
Dorothy Pierens - 15 - Utah, Sault Lake C. - paralysed ... O.K .. 3 yrs. ago.
Josephine Mrs. Casgrain - 37 - of Monteray, Calif. - mental & pneu- monia & Emphysema -
Mrs. H. J. Schlaf - 33 - fears tumor on brain - has been having trouble with eyes & head.
Mr. Deboucher ....
John Maher - 69 - in Providence - operation
